title: The unit of extension by zero along an open immersion is an isomorphism
statement: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], let $j_!:\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(X_{\Et})$ be the extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] on abelian sheaves of the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $j^{-1}:\Ab(X_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $\eta^!_j:\mathrm{id}\to j^{-1}j_!$ the unit of the adjunction $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Then for every $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ the unit $\eta^!_{j,F}:F\to j^{-1}j_!F$ is an isomorphism; that is, $\eta^!_j$ is a natural isomorphism $\mathrm{id}_{\Ab(U_{\Et})}\xrightarrow{\sim}j^{-1}j_!$.
